items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09
items.q: They call themselves Bob Haggart, Yank Lawson, greatest, world's greatest jazz band.

ctx.x: I'd like to ask Mr. Miller a question. Aren't some of your old friends from the Bob Crosby days back together again, and don't they have a band playing somewhere in New York?
Yes, they do. They call themselves Bob Haggart, Yank Lawson, greatest, world's greatest jazz band.
Are they playing at the Plaza they're playing now?
